summary.text: Jeremy Munson is the Republican candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 22 in the November 3, 2026 general election and a former state representative.
He represented District 23B in the Minnesota House of Representatives from February 2018 to January 2023.

paragraphs.text: Munson earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Minnesota, and Ballotpedia lists business analyst among his career experience.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he lives on a farm near Lake Crystal with his wife, Kallie, and their two daughters.
Munson assumed office in the Minnesota House on February 20, 2018, succeeding Tony Cornish, and left office on January 3, 2023, after not running for re-election in 2022.
For 2021 and 2022 he was assigned to the House Redistricting Committee and the Climate and Energy Finance and Policy Committee.
In the survey he said he spent five years on Health and Human Services committees.
Munson named eliminating fraud and waste, health care price transparency, and lobbying and campaign finance reform as his campaign priorities.
He listed endorsements from the Minnesota Police and Peace Officers Association, Minnesota Farm Bureau, the Minnesota Chamber of Commerce, the National Rifle Association and the Republican Party.
